invariants.rationale: atlas.findRegion(regionName) is expected to return a TextureRegion for valid input; method likely never returns null.
Return value of atlas.findRegion is a TextureRegion or null; at exit, if non-null, must be TextureRegion.
Method expects a non-null argument name; parseRegionName would fail on null.
parseRegionName(name) must return a valid regionName string for atlas.findRegion.
Method returns atlas.findRegion(parseRegionName(name)), so result always equals this expression.
